svg.title: LCC HVDC: synchronized rectifier and inverter commutation states
svg.text: Commutation windows referenced to the rectifier event; station offset is illustrative

text.font-family: STIX Math, STIX, Cambria Math, DejaVu Serif, serif

svg.text: Overlap intervals show which devices conduct; red does not quantify current sharing.
The station offset is illustrative, not a power-system phase lock or transformer phase shift.
